description: The chart illustrates CoLeG-R performance (in percent) for three LLaMA-2 model sizes under four SFT (supervised fine-tuning) conditions. The horizontal axis lists the model categories LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B from left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “CoLeG-R (%)” on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick marks every 10. Each model category contains a grouped set of four vertical bars arranged side-by-side: a blue diagonally hatched bar labeled “no SFT,” an orange horizontally hatched bar labeled “+ SFT on D0,” a purple diagonally hatched bar labeled “+ SFT on D0, D1,” and a solid red bar labeled “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2.” For LLaMA-2-7B, the bars are approximately 67 (no SFT), 66 (+SFT on D0), 81 (+SFT on D0, D1), and 83 (+SFT on D0, D1, D2). For LLaMA-2-13B, the bars are approximately 70, 74, 84, and 80 in the same legend order. For LLaMA-2-70B, the bars are approximately 81, 82, 84, and 83. The bars are not sorted by height within groups, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct colors and hatch patterns indicated in the legend.
